key_facts: Develops and maintains growmos, MIT (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md)

summary: Codician (codician.com) is the organization that develops and maintains growmos under the MIT license, owns the codician.com domain that anchors the com.codician namespace on the MCP Registry, and hosts the project at github.com/codician-team.
